item.title: Rutherford House Relisted: Beverly Hills mansion returns at $35 million; reflects soaring value
item.description: A Beverly Hills mansion, once owned by actress Ann Rutherford, is back on the market for $35 million. item.title: ¿Qué implica el nódulo pulmonar detectado al papa León XIV y qué riesgos hay en su operación?
item.description: La salud del papa León XIV vuelve a ser tema de atención internacional después de que el Vaticano informara del hallazgo de un nódulo pulmonar localizado y detectado en una fase muy temprana. item.title: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die
item.description: Dozens of CIA officers have been afflicted by debilitating symptoms over the past decade. Are they the result of ‘mass hysteria’? Or are they from attacks with an energy weapon and, if so, who is responsible? And has there been a cover-up? Shortly after 1am one night in April 2019, a CIA officer on a work trip to London was jolted awake in his hotel room by the most intense head pain he had ever experienced. His body was soaked with sweat and he felt like his eyes were spinning in their sockets. item.title: Russia slashes cancer care as defence spending hits post-Soviet record
item.description: The federal cancer programme budget falls from 44.9 billion to 3.87 billion roubles in 2027 — a nearly 40-fold reduction against 2025 levels — as defence spending reaches 35% of all federal expenditure, the highest share since the Soviet Union collapsed. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln regresa a EE. UU. tras alarmas por la salud mental de la tripulación
item.description: El portaaviones USS Abraham Lincoln regresó a Estados Unidos para el alivio de los marineros a bordo y sus familiares. El barco permaneció más de siete meses en altamar en una misión para presionar a Irán tras permanecer dos meses en el Pacífico, por lo que se habrían acabado suministros de higiene y alimentación, por lo que se habían expresado alertas por la salud mental de los tripulantes. Nuestra corresponsal Carolina Valladares nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: New York mayor urges Trump to remove ICE after driver with child in car is shot
item.description: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Thursday he would ask US President Donald Trump to remove federal immigration agents from the city as tensions flared over the latest shooting involving ICE. The New York Police Department said a man had been shot around 4pm in the Marble Hill neighbourhood of the Bronx during an altercation with federal agents.
